messages.subject: Plan names — quick brainstorm
messages.body:
Hi Priya!

Since we're tidying the pricing page for v3 anyway — 'Starter / Pro / Enterprise' is so 2019. Some alternatives, riffing on the logistics vibe:

- Courier / Fleet / Command
- Small / — no wait, nobody wants to buy "Small"
- Dash / Drive / Depot
- Pulse / Pilot / Prime

I personally love Dash / Drive / Depot, it alliterates AND it scales. I can mock up the pricing page variants this week!

Chloe

messages.subject: RE: Plan names — quick brainstorm
messages.body:
Hi Chloe,

Fun exercise, but a caution from the product side: every rename touches billing, the pricing page, invoices, docs and every proposal template — and we're mid-Ledgerly-prep, so plan-name churn right now would create real billing complexity. If it happens at all it should be after the cutover and probably after launch.

Thanks!
Priya

messages.subject: RE: Plan names — quick brainstorm
messages.body:
Fair! I'll park the mocks until things calm down. For the record Depot is the best name, when we revisit, remember I called it 😄

Chloe
